title: Auto-research with codex: How I achieved a 232x Faster Kernel
summary: The article describes using OpenAI's Codex to automate kernel optimization research, achieving a 232x speedup. It details an iterative workflow where Codex analyzes, profiles, and rewrites CUDA kernels, demonstrating AI-driven performance engineering. The approach combines automated experimentation with human oversight, highlighting practical benefits and limitations of LLM-assisted code optimization.
